mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 3.08% is below the historical median, and historically, such low rates have been associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. Therefore, the mechanism predicts positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all trading days, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 300 signals high inflation, which historically has been associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The current CPIAUCSL is 298.062, so the trigger condition is not met, but the mechanism is active when the condition is met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a federal funds rate below 3.5% and CPIAUCSL above 300 signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that historically has been associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 300, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
